title: orthodon leucanthus
intro: Orthodon leucanthus, commonly known as white antelopehorn, is a type of flowering plant in the family Asteraceae. This plant is believed to possess various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may help in reducing inflammation, protecting against cell damage, and preventing infections. The therapeutic actions of Orthodon leucanthus include its use in traditional medicine to treat digestive issues, wounds, and respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
